branded.why: One dairy's or company's product, sold in its shops but no part of a food culture beyond them.

about.text: A naturally ripened semi-hard cut cheese from Bergader Privatkäserei in Waging am See, Bavaria, cold-smoked over beech and spruce wood. It is named after the company's founder, Basil Weixler.

sources.text: Its smoking, type and naming, from this page.
